# ARWP Agent Skills

Use these portable skills when an AI coding agent should improve, prepare or maintain a website under ARWP.

## Default growth workflow
- arwp-growth-loop — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-growth-loop/SKILL.md

Use it for Search growth, Google Discover/recommendations, generative Search, AI citations, current platform adaptation and ongoing evidence-backed website improvement.

## Initial preparation
- arwp-prepare-site — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-prepare-site/SKILL.md

## Specialists
- arwp-ai-search-content — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-ai-search-content/SKILL.md
- arwp-agent-discovery — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-agent-discovery/SKILL.md
- arwp-evidence-ci — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/skills/arwp-evidence-ci/SKILL.md

## Install
npx skills add dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile

## Rule
Research -> hypothesis -> implement -> verify -> measure. Do not claim that ARWP, llms.txt, Schema.org, Agent Skills or another metadata mechanism guarantees ranking, Discover placement, AI citation, recommendations or traffic.
